title: Lou Holtz, head coach of the Jets and six college programs, dies at 89

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Lou Holtz, head coach of the Jets and six college programs, dies at 89
sources.description: Lou Holtz, who spent one season as head coach of the Jets but is better remembered as the only coach in college football history to lead six different programs to bowl games, has died at the age of 89.
